question: Where’s the closest hotel along the path to Mini Mart, San Francisco, CA starting at Bowditch Middle School Auditorium, Foster City, CA?
sql: WITH start_point AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Bowditch Middle School Auditorium%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Foster City%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%CA%' LIMIT 1 ), end_point AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Mini Mart%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%San Francisco%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%CA%' LIMIT 1 ), path_corridor AS ( SELECT ST_Buffer(ST_MakeLine(sp.geometry, ep.geometry)::geography, 1000) AS corridor_geom -- 1km buffer around the direct path FROM start_point sp, end_point ep ) SELECT p.id, p.poi_name, p.addr_state, p.addr_city FROM pois p, end_point ep WHERE p.tourism ILIKE '%hotel%' AND ST_Intersects(p.geometry::geography, (SELECT corridor_geom FROM path_corridor)) ORDER BY ST_Distance(p.geometry::geography, ep.geometry::geography) ASC LIMIT 1;
